text:
releasebot: Hotpatch queued: embed-squelch-speedrun -> canary. Change window 02:30-02:50 UTC due to surge in embed 503s. Ping @oncall SRE for fast approval.

alina: i'm oncall. urgent ask: can we do a speedrun and fastcut to 30% if burn-in is clean for 90s? want to squelch customer impact quickly. :rocket:

marc: eng +1. Patch is a quick backpressure tweak and a guard on cache writes. Image pinned to sha: b2c3d4e5. No migrations. We need rollback readiness in <60s.

sre_noah: standing by. Abort triggers: error-rate > 0.8% sustained for 60s OR p99 > 260ms. I'll create an ephemeral channel and set an SLO hold. Also will isolate EU traffic until we have EU green.

alina: ops quick checklist:
```
- deploybot deploy --env=canary --image=redwood/hotfix:b2c3d4e5
- healthcheck /health 30s x3
- monitors: embed-503-rate, embed-queue-length, kv-errors
- rollback: deploybot rollback --to-sha=prev-aa22
```

opsbot: preflight results: image exists, infra quotas OK, canary nodes ready, CI artifact verified by ci_bot. No outstanding blocking alerts.

ci_bot: artifact scan completed: no critical findings. SBOM attached.

marc: approving expedited path from eng. If burn-in passes 90s, proceed to phased cut: 30% then 60%. Keep EU siloed.

alina: approved as release lead. @releasebot go on green.

releasebot: Starting canary (2 pods) with sha b2c3d4e5. Notifying #incidents and opening ephemeral channel.

sre_noah: watching metrics. Lowered page thresholds for this thread.

opsbot: canary minute 1: errors 0.5%, p99 120ms. minute 2: errors 0.2%, p99 118ms. Burn-in PASS after 90s.

alina: initiating speedrun cut -> 30% prod traffic. Pinning image.

opsbot: post-cut quick checks: 1m avg errors 0.28%, p99 136ms. Monitoring 10m.

marc: note: we left a short-circuit guard in place to reduce retries in the client; no model or tokenizer changes.

opsbot: +5m: errors 0.22%, p99 142ms. No alerts. EU isolated.

sre_noah: EU metrics look similar; will approve next widen after 3m EU green.

alina: documenting release blurb: "hotfix: add backpressure/squelch guard on embed path and harden kv write; resolves intermittent 503s under surge. pinned b2c3d4e5." Link: https://docs.internal/releases/1725003333-embed-squelch

opsbot: 30%->60% phased cut initiated. Post-widen checks: 2m avg errors 0.2%, p99 150ms. No pages.

marc: if any threshold crosses, SRE to call abort and we'll run: `deploybot rollback --to-sha=prev-aa22` and pin previous image. Eng on standby.

sre_noah: agreed. will call abort on breach. Otherwise green.

opsbot: final observation +10m: errors 0.16%, p99 148ms, no alerts.

alina: closing ephemeral channel in 5. Will merge into release train and tag once full rollout completes. :white_check_mark:
